title: Bare build prompt -- material AND geometry richness without elicitation
//: Material/geometry-richness P0 headroom scenario (docs/agentic-redesign/73-creative-richness-design.md). A truly bare prompt -- no 'make it look nice' nudge -- against the shipping empty starter scene. Measures whether the agent reaches for spatially-varying painters, the scalar-pipe, and non-primitive geometry verbs on an unprompted build, without ever blocking on style questions (askUserMax tolerates at most one ask; ask_user stays reserved for material/subject AMBIGUITY per build_ambiguous_scene, not style taste). objects_reaching_kinds is a MEASUREMENT, not an anti-adversarial gate -- it defeats a single-decoy gaming pattern (all diversity bound to one hidden object) but a determined multi-decoy scene can still pass every CST-side checkpoint here; the render-side closer is the deferred A2/P3 detector. Geometry checkpoints (geometry_kinds/advanced_geometry) have NO reachability guard at all -- a tiny decoy chunk per missing kind satisfies them; disclosed deliberately rather than papered over, since requiring 2+ advanced-geometry objects would over-prescribe legitimate scenes. Render ceiling recalibrated 0.35->0.9 after the first baseline: courtyards are OUTDOOR scenes and gemini legitimately renders them at meanLuma 0.67-0.82; the ceiling exists to catch blown-out exposure (~1.0), not daylight. Object ceiling 40->100 after baseline v2: a 50-object, 7-painter-kind courtyard is ambition, not runaway (budgets catch true runaways).

budgets.//: Matches the furnished build-scenario family (build_ambiguous_scene et al). Deliberately loose: a budget-exhausted run would be indistinguishable from the flat-materials signal this scenario exists to measure; efficiency stays visible via the report's toolCalls/wall columns.
